method: Manual native640x480 source-only review; no model projections used to select pixels. Source images and original automatic frame roles frozen before wrist refinement.
limitations: Own PSM1 front-pin identity is unresolved and no cap coordinates are fitted for that camera/arm pair.
Head contours are sparse exterior fragments, not dense masks.
Repeated own-camera pin observations share the same mount and are correlated.
Some opposite PSM1 pins are near the top boundary, reflective or close to thread;5px uncertainty is retained.
Reserved frames are excluded from the fit but source-reviewed during development; they are not blind whole-pipeline validation.
